user_instruction: 我批准了。此外要求不用过严，不显著退步即可。
supersedes: selection_policy.json eligibility requiring zero point-estimate regression
time_of_adoption: After scout/review_scout completed, before any confirmation request or score
selection_reason: Single-call NLI improves exploratory challenge accuracy by 3/21 while losing 1/21 basic; dual has the same challenge score but loses 2/21 basic; blind review adds cost and returns exactly baseline performance.
confirmatory_data: planned_confirmation.json: 60 basic + 41 challenge, 14 new complete dev groups, already frozen before scout aggregate scores
statistics: Report paired accuracy differences, 95% group-bootstrap intervals, exact two-sided group sign-flip tests, and all three recall differences separately by dataset. Significant means an unadjusted paired group test p < 0.05; any observed significant regression is flagged conservatively. Group-level dependencies are retained. Per-mechanism small-group results are descriptive.
interpretation: Absence of a significant loss is not proof of noninferiority. Report every observed decline and its interval, especially with few groups or few REFUTES examples. Do not invent a noninferiority margin or declare every metric improved when it did not.
promotion: Treat as a promising development candidate if at least one dataset improves and no statistically significant regression appears in accuracy, macro F1 or class recalls on either dataset; also report effect sizes and cost. A result with broad intervals remains uncertain.
no_adaptation: No prompt, sample, label or decision-rule changes from partial confirmation results. Keep original strict gate results as a diagnostic.
test_policy: Test remains sealed and is not needed for this development experiment.
